description: Scans with a scan count of exactly 11 are kept.

b.request: For scans with `scancount` ≥ 11 that have a matching site on `scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry`, group by site code and historical phase; return each group’s unrounded average `scancount` and average `pressratio`, ignoring null values, for the 10 groups with the highest average `pressratio`, with null averages last.
b.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, t.phasefactor AS historical_phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount >= 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST, s.zoneref, t.phasefactor LIMIT 10;
b.raw: For scans with `scancount` ≥ 11 that have a matching site on `scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry`, group by site code and historical phase; return each group’s unrounded average `scancount` and average `pressratio`, ignoring null values, for the 10 groups with the highest average `pressratio`, with null averages last.

d.request: For each site code and historical phase, join scans to sites, retain scans with `scancount >= 11`, calculate the unrounded averages of nonmissing `scancount` and `pressratio`, and return the 10 groups with the highest average compression ratio, placing missing averages last.
d.sql: SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.phasefactor AS historical_phase, AVG(sc.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(sc.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.scancount >= 11 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

a.request: Join scans to their sites on `scans.zoneref` = `sites.zoneregistry`, dropping unmatched scans. Keep only scans whose `scancount` is at least 11. Group by site code (`scans.zoneref`) and historical phase (`sites.phasefactor`). For each group, give the site code, the phase, the average `scancount` and the average compression ratio (`pressratio`), each ignoring missing values. Sort by average compression ratio, highest first with missing last, keep the first 10 rows, and don't round.
a.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, t.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans AS s INNER JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount >= 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

c.request: For scans whose `scancount` clears the 11-scan mark, linked to their sites through `scans.zoneref` = `sites.zoneregistry` (scans without a site left out), what are the average `scancount` and the average compression ratio (`pressratio`) for each site code (`scans.zoneref`) and historical phase (`sites.phasefactor`)? Ignore missing values and don't round. Show the site code, the phase and both averages for the 10 combinations with the highest average compression ratio, with missing values last. Scans with a scan count of exactly 11 are kept.
c.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, t.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount >= 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
